convert_levit_128s_timm_checkpoint: convert a LeViT 128S timm checkpoint to HuggingFace LevitForImageClassificationWithTeacher format
convert_levit_384_timm_checkpoint: convert a LeViT 384 timm checkpoint to HuggingFace LevitForImageClassificationWithTeacher format
convert_all_levit_models_timm: convert all supported LeViT timm models (128S, 128, 192, 256, 384) to HuggingFace format
push_levit_conversion_to_hub: convert a LeViT timm model and push the checkpoint and image processor to HuggingFace Hub
run_levit_conversion_cli: run the LeViT timm-to-pytorch conversion script via argparse with custom output directory
